name: Frontier Erotica (Fundamentals)
source:
A kinetic training module with built-in networking opportunities. Participants will engage meaningfully with the howling vortex of fundamental erotica, apply core concepts and lean voidwards. Perhaps you will grow. 

[From [url=https://mindape.itch.io/fundamentals-of-frontier-erotica]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一個內含社交機會的無選項訓練單元。參與者將深入接觸基礎情色那呼嘯的漩渦，運用核心概念，向虛空傾身。也許，你會有所成長。
